title: Neural Network Accelerator
description: A custom CUDA kernel implementation for accelerating transformer attention mechanisms. Achieves 3.2× throughput vs baseline PyTorch on A100 GPUs.

title: CLI Dev Toolkit
description: A terminal-native developer workflow toolkit built in Go. Bundles git aliases, project scaffolding, and environment switching into a single binary.

title: Distributed Task Engine
description: A fault-tolerant job scheduler for distributed ML training pipelines. Handles checkpointing, failure recovery, and dynamic resource allocation.

title: Robotic Motion Planner
description: Real-time inverse kinematics solver for 6-DoF robotic arms using ROS2. Integrates with vision pipeline for autonomous object manipulation.
